//: The copy step is load-bearing, not housekeeping.
`mastra build` bundles JavaScript into a flat function directory and copies
no other assets. src/content/platform holds the platform documentation
corpus — plain Markdown read from disk at request time, deliberately never
ingested into Pinecone — so without this the deployed function has NO
platform docs at all. It failed silently: the tier answered nothing, and
'what can this assistant do' abstained in production while passing every
local test, because in dev the files are simply there.
The destination is the function root because the bundle is flat; the runtime
resolver in platform-docs-tier.ts looks for `content/platform` beside the
entrypoint. If the deployer's output layout ever changes, the corpus loader
now throws and logs CORPUS FAILED TO LOAD rather than degrading quietly.
